items.title: Jay Leonhart interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: I’m able to keep track of Milt’s birthday perfectly because he is thirty days [years] to the day older than my wife.

ctx.x: No, that’s not what I was talking about, but I know you had a nice sentiment in that double CD they put out that had that nice book in it.

Right. And I put a poem in it, which is actually a song, which had been performed at his 80th birthday. I’m able to keep track of Milt’s birthday perfectly because he is thirty days [years] to the day older than my wife. So when she has a birthday, he has a birthday and he’s thirty years older. Yet somehow she’s fifty years younger. Now that is an interesting bit of mathematics.
I think you should write a song about that too.
